product.description:
The Spruce outdoor insert is a one-piece liner that can be installed in wall or island applications. Spruce includes corrosion-resistant, 304-grade stainless steel and powerful 1,200-CFM internal blowers to handle the most intense grilling. Also featuring 3-speed metallic knob controls, LumiLight LED lighting, and pro baffle filters to enhance airflow.

Features:

  • Illuminates cooking surfaces perfectly with LumiLight LED lighting
  • Made with high quality 304S stainless steel for durability and longevity
  • Rated for outdoor use to finish any outdoor cooking area with style and performance
  • Professional dishwasher safe stainless steel baffle filters
  • Find your perfect speed with a 3 speed metallic easy to use knob dial
  • Uses a powerful 1200 cfm blower
  • Compatible with vertical 10 in. round ducting
  • Covered under a 1 Year Labor, 3 Year Parts manufacturer warranty

Specifications:

  • CFM: 450, 1200
  • Sones: 3.5, 9
  • Nominal Width: 42"
  • Width: 40-3/8"
  • Height: 12"
  • Depth: 22-1/2"
  • Duct Size: 10" Round
  • Ceiling Height: 96" - 108"
  • Height Above Cooktop: 30" to 36"
  • Amperage: 8A
  • Voltage: 120V
  • Wattage: 960W
